Rishi / Marissa —

I've started populating the VSRQ. High-level tech/legal positions from Security/Infra: 

1) SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation for our hosted inference platform (report 2025). We can provide a redacted report under NDA and a one-page summary (attached: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf). For Dedicated and Private deployments, evidence differs: Dedicated customers can request a scoped SOC 2 addendum and Private/on-prem customers are outside our control plane scope; we provide architecture docs and controls mapping.

2) Encryption & backups: Hosted service backups are encrypted at rest using KMS-managed keys. For enterprise Dedicated customers we offer customer-owned KMS (BYOK) integration so keys are under customer control. Backups are versioned and stored in geo-redundant storage with lifecycle rules.

3) Deletion SLA: Standard hosted offering supports account/data deletion from primary/active stores within 30 days of request. However, backup purge timelines are operationally 90 days by default due to restore windows and storage replication; we can contractually commit to 90 days for backup purge. For customers requiring a shorter backup purge window (e.g., 30 days), we typically require Dedicated or Private deployment or a contractual premium and operations runbook to ensure faster purges. We should propose: primary deletion within 30 days, backup purge within 90 days; optional expedited purge (30–45 days) as a negotiated term.

4) Audit/log retention: Default audit log retention is 365 days for the hosted product. We can offer shorter retention (90 days) via configuration for enterprise customers, but shorter retention may limit forensic investigations. For EU customers with minimization requirements we can propose a tailored retention policy and mapping of logs to minimize PII.

5) Backups & cold storage deletion: Cold snapshot removal is part of the backup purge process; we track lineage and can provide deletion receipts for contractual commitments.

Recommended contractual language (short):
"Redwood will delete Customer Data from active production stores within thirty (30) days of termination or deletion request. Redwood will purge Customer Data from backup and archival systems within ninety (90) days, unless otherwise agreed in writing. For customers requiring an accelerated backup purge, Redwood may offer an expedited purge schedule as part of a Dedicated or Private deployment addendum for an additional fee."

Next steps I suggest: we complete the questionnaire and include the language above as a proposed clause. If Fintegrate requires 30-day backup purge for hosted SaaS, we escalate to legal/pricing because that's an exception.

I'll continue filling the VSRQ; Dev, can you add the technical KMS/BYOK steps and the backup retention lifecycle in the next pass?

Regards,
